description: This file contains a serializer (CompareInfoCodec) for the .NET CompareInfo class, handling serialization and deserialization of CompareInfo objects for Orleans serialization framework.

classes.name: CompareInfoCodec
classes.description: Serializer class for CompareInfo objects, implementing IFieldCodec<CompareInfo>.

methods.name: ReadValue
methods.description: Reads a CompareInfo object from the serialized data, reconstructing it based on its name field.

methods.name: WriteField
methods.description: Serializes a CompareInfo object to the output stream.
